name: Blue-Top Steering Gears Inc.
old_description: In 2011, Ryan (Myron's son), purchased the business.  During that time Ryan re-established the business in Stanton, North Dakota. He reorganized and started pushing the business area across the United States.  Ryan's experience re-manufacturing steering gears with another large company in Seattle, Washington helped him with the understanding of many different types of steering components and the re-manufacturing process.  With the new location, better facilities, and a lot of years ahead, he pushed harder expanding sales from coast to coast. By this time Ryan had updated most of the equipment and had purchased more machining equipment to be able to keep all work in-house.  In 2017 Blue-Top Steering expanded into re-manufacturing steering valves and steering cylinders to add to the service abilities.  Since 2017 the business has grown every month as more people look to have a quality product installed on their vehicle to keep them steering straight down the road.
about:
Blue-Top Steering Gears operates from Stanton, North Dakota. In 2011, Ryan, son of the previous owner Myron, purchased the business and re-established it in Stanton. Ryan brought experience from re-manufacturing steering gears with a large company in Seattle, Washington.

The company remanufactures steering gears, steering valves, and steering cylinders for a range of heavy-duty and light-duty trucks. All machining and assembly work is kept in-house, with the facility equipped for complete remanufacturing. The product line covers applications for Ford Super Duty (F-250 through F-550), Chevrolet/GMC 2500HD and 3500HD, Dodge Ram 1500/2500/3500, and Jeep models from the 1980s through early 2000s. The company also offers a rebuild-and-return service for customers' own OEM cores.

Blue-Top serves the automotive aftermarket, primarily repair shops, fleet operators, and individual vehicle owners seeking replacement steering components. Its catalog includes dozens of part numbers tailored to specific model years and configurations, such as 32-spline and 36-spline output shafts for Ford trucks and various master-spline arrangements for GM and Dodge axles.

The business emphasizes a quality product at a competitive price, a stance reflected in its core-exchange policy that grants full credit only for OEM cores. Ryan's background in large-scale remanufacturing informed the decision to bring all processes under one roof, allowing tighter control over turnaround and consistency.
